lines.zh: 篷车吱呀作响，载运虫拉着我慢慢走。
lines.en: The wagon creaks as the carrier bug drags me along.

lines.zh: 我走过平原，也走过恶地的红沙。
lines.en: I have crossed plains and the red sand of badlands.

lines.zh: 车板上摆满货物，走起来叮当作响。
lines.en: The bed is packed with goods that clink as we roll.

lines.zh: 我一天走不了多远，货太重了。
lines.en: I do not get far in a day; the load is heavy.

lines.zh: 载运虫认得路，我只管坐着算账。
lines.en: The carrier bug knows the road; I just sit and tally.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥粘住车轮，我得下来推。
lines.en: Swamp mud grips the wheels, so I get down and push.

lines.zh: 我沿途记下每个村子的位置。
lines.en: I note the position of every village along the way.

lines.zh: 风把我的篷布吹得啪啪响。
lines.en: The wind snaps my canvas again and again.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，好东西值得等。
lines.en: I travel slowly; fine goods are worth waiting for.

lines.zh: 车轮碾过草，压出一条新路。
lines.en: My wheels roll over grass and press out a new path.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的峡谷边停了停，太晒。
lines.en: I paused by a badlands canyon; the sun was too much.

lines.zh: 载运虫饿了，我得先喂它。
lines.en: The carrier bug is hungry, and it eats before I do.

lines.zh: 这条路上，我认识每一块奇怪的石子。
lines.en: On this road I know every odd stone by sight.

lines.zh: 我走的是生意路，不是逃亡路。
lines.en: This is a trade route I walk, not a flight.

lines.zh: 我拽了拽缰绳，载运虫才肯走。
lines.en: I tug the reins before my carrybug moves.

lines.zh: 过了山口，风大得掀我的帽檐。
lines.en: Past the pass the wind lifts my hat brim.

lines.zh: 我把货物一件件摆正，摆了三遍。
lines.en: I straighten the goods one by one, three times over.

lines.zh: 我数着今天的收成，还差两种。
lines.en: I count today's haul: two kinds still missing.

lines.zh: 载运虫在打盹，触须还在动。
lines.en: The carrier bug dozes, antennae still twitching.

lines.zh: 我给每件异物都起了名字。
lines.en: I have named every strange item I carry.

lines.zh: 这枚鳞片，我出价三个绿宝石。
lines.en: For this scale I would offer three emeralds.

lines.zh: 我擦了擦秤，其实它没脏。
lines.en: I wipe the scale, though it is not dirty.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我就跟货物说话。
lines.en: When no one comes, I talk to the merchandise.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾漫过来，我把篷布放下。
lines.en: Swamp fog rolls in and I lower the canvas.

lines.zh: 我在账本上画了一只没见过的虫子。
lines.en: I sketch a bug I have never seen in my ledger.

lines.zh: 风一停，车轮就不响了，反而安静得怪。
lines.en: When the wind dies the wheels go silent, oddly quiet.

lines.zh: 我把最贵的东西藏在座位底下。
lines.en: I keep the priciest pieces under my seat.

lines.zh: 我在等一个识货的人经过。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who knows value to pass.

lines.zh: 你身上有异兽的味道，我闻得出来。
lines.en: You smell of critters; I can tell.

lines.zh: 让我看看你的背包，就一眼。
lines.en: Let me see your pack, just one glance.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着沼泽泥，是从那边来的吧。
lines.en: Your boots carry swamp mud; you came from over there.

lines.zh: 你眼神在货上停了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes rested on my goods; I noticed.

lines.zh: 别急着走，我们谈谈价钱。
lines.en: Do not rush off; let us talk price.

lines.zh: 你的手很稳，是个能干活的人。
lines.en: Your hands are steady; you are a working sort.

lines.zh: 你身上这件皮甲，料子不一般。
lines.en: That leather armor of yours is unusual material.

lines.zh: 我在你腰上看到一枚没见过的甲片。
lines.en: I see a shell plate at your belt that I do not know.

lines.zh: 你是来卖的，还是来买的？
lines.en: Are you here to sell, or to buy?

lines.zh: 你站远点，影子挡住我的货了。
lines.en: Stand back; your shadow is on my goods.

lines.zh: 别打我，我只是个做生意的。
lines.en: Do not hit me; I am only a trader.

lines.zh: 这一下撞歪了我的秤。
lines.en: That knock bent my scale out of true.

lines.zh: 我的帽子掉了，货也散了。
lines.en: My hat fell off and my goods scattered.

lines.zh: 疼，但我更心疼货。
lines.en: It hurts, but the goods hurt me more.

lines.zh: 载运虫惊了，车差点翻。
lines.en: The carrier bug bolted and the wagon nearly tipped.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，经不起这一拳。
lines.en: At my age I cannot take a punch like that.

lines.zh: 血滴在账本上，弄脏了。
lines.en: Blood dripped on the ledger and stained it.

lines.zh: 我捂着肋骨，还在算损失。
lines.en: I hold my ribs and keep calculating the loss.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别碰我的箱子。
lines.en: Hit me if you must, but leave the crates alone.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，先护住车。
lines.en: I back off two steps and guard the wagon first.

lines.zh: 你手里那件东西，我很想收。
lines.en: That thing in your hand, I would very much like to buy.

lines.zh: 一枚绿宝石，能换我半车货。
lines.en: One emerald could take half my wagon.

lines.zh: 你拿出样品，我的手指就动了。
lines.en: You show a sample and my fingers start moving.

lines.zh: 那种壳我只见过一次，再让我看看。
lines.en: I have seen that shell once; let me look again.

lines.zh: 你要是肯便宜点，我立刻装车。
lines.en: Drop the price and I load it immediately.

lines.zh: 我对异兽的东西没有抵抗力。
lines.en: I have no resistance to critter goods.

lines.zh: 那根羽毛，我出双倍。
lines.en: For that feather I will pay double.

lines.zh: 你还没开价，我已经在心里算完了。
lines.en: You have not named a price and I have finished the math.

lines.zh: 好东西摆在眼前，我走不动路。
lines.en: Good goods right in front of me and my legs stop working.

lines.zh: 你把东西收回口袋，我心都凉了。
lines.en: You put it back in your pocket and my heart sinks.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的车，货晃了一整排。
lines.en: You hit my wagon and a whole row of goods swayed.

lines.zh: 小心，那箱子里全是易碎品。
lines.en: Careful, that crate is all fragile stock.

lines.zh: 载运虫被你吓了一跳，往旁边挪。
lines.en: The carrier bug startled and shifted aside.

lines.zh: 你撞的是秤，秤很准，别碰。
lines.en: You bumped the scale; it is accurate, leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我的帽子掉了。
lines.en: We collided and my hat came off.

lines.zh: 这一下，我损失了两件货物。
lines.en: That cost me two items of stock.

lines.zh: 你站稳了，我的车轮卡在泥里。
lines.en: You found your feet; my wheels are stuck in mud.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，篷车的木头不结实。
lines.en: Do not lean on it; the wagon wood is not strong.

lines.zh: 我扶住货箱，才没让它翻。
lines.en: I caught the crate before it tipped over.

lines.zh: 载运虫冲你叫了一声，它脾气不好。
lines.en: The carrier bug barked at you; it has a temper.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在另一条商路上，一年见一次。
lines.en: My partner runs another trade road; we meet once a year.

lines.zh: 我们交换的不是戒指，是账本。
lines.en: What we exchanged was not rings but ledgers.

lines.zh: 她收骨头，我收甲壳，正好互补。
lines.en: She takes bone, I take shell, and we complement each other.

lines.zh: 我们约好，谁先发财谁先回来。
lines.en: We agreed whoever gets rich first comes back first.

lines.zh: 我给她留了最好的一枚鳞片。
lines.en: I saved her the finest scale I ever had.

lines.zh: 两个人的车队，才能走更远的路。
lines.en: Two wagons can travel a much longer road.

lines.zh: 她笑的时候，比一枚绿宝石好看。
lines.en: Her laugh is worth more than an emerald to me.

lines.zh: 我们靠信使传价，也传一句平安。
lines.en: Couriers carry our prices, and one line saying we are well.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字刻在车辕内侧。
lines.en: I carved her name inside the wagon shaft.

lines.zh: 等这趟货卖完，我就去找她。
lines.en: When this load is sold, I will go find her.

lines.zh: 地上那枚甲片，我一眼就看见了。
lines.en: I spotted that shell plate on the ground at once.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，吹掉上面的土。
lines.en: I bend, pick it up, and blow the dirt off.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的？没人应，那就是我的了。
lines.en: Who dropped this? No answer, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很快，这是职业习惯。
lines.en: I pick things up fast; it is an occupational habit.

lines.zh: 一颗奇怪的牙齿，值不少钱。
lines.en: An odd tooth like this is worth a fair amount.

lines.zh: 我把它放进标着待估的袋子。
lines.en: I drop it in the bag marked for appraisal.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，我捡起来，先谈价。
lines.en: You dropped something; I have it, so let us talk price.

lines.zh: 我从不空手走过一片战场。
lines.en: I never walk across a battlefield empty-handed.

lines.zh: 这枚壳裂了，但还能卖。
lines.en: This shell is cracked, but it will still sell.

lines.zh: 我捡到的每样东西，都记在账上。
lines.en: Everything I pick up goes into the ledger.

lines.zh: 那边有人背着鼓鼓的包。
lines.en: Someone over there has a bulging pack.

lines.zh: 我看见他腰间挂着一串甲片。
lines.en: I see a string of shell plates at his waist.

lines.zh: 那队人从沼泽方向来，肯定有货。
lines.en: That group came from the swamp and must have goods.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能看清他手里的东西。
lines.en: At this distance I can make out what he holds.

lines.zh: 他的袋子在动，里面是活的？
lines.en: His bag is moving; is something alive in there?

lines.zh: 有生意的地方，我就看得见。
lines.en: Where there is trade to be had, I see it.

lines.zh: 那个人在犹豫，正是好时机。
lines.en: He is hesitating, which is the perfect moment.

lines.zh: 我让载运虫慢下来，先看看货。
lines.en: I slow the carrier bug to look over the goods.

lines.zh: 他手上的东西，我从没见过。
lines.en: I have never seen the thing in his hands.

lines.zh: 谁带着异兽的零件，谁就是我的客人。
lines.en: Anyone carrying critter parts is my customer.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比秤还准。
lines.en: My eyes are more accurate than my scale.

lines.zh: 他往这边看了，我要先开口。
lines.en: He glanced this way; I should speak first.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的袋子，不是盯着他的人。
lines.en: I am watching his bag, not the man himself.

lines.zh: 再走近些，我就能报个价。
lines.en: A little closer and I can quote a price.

lines.zh: 他还在考虑，我不催，只等。
lines.en: He is still deciding; I do not push, I wait.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的一件货摆在车头。
lines.en: I set my brightest piece at the front of the wagon.

lines.zh: 这个客人不能放走。
lines.en: This customer cannot be allowed to walk away.

lines.zh: 我算好了三种价格，等他挑。
lines.en: I have three prices ready for him to choose from.

lines.zh: 他手伸向口袋了，有戏。
lines.en: His hand went to his pocket; this may work.

lines.zh: 我把秤摆正，笑容也摆正。
lines.en: I square the scale and square my smile.

lines.zh: 他一犹豫，我就加一句好话。
lines.en: Every hesitation of his gets one more kind word from me.

lines.zh: 我盯得他不好意思走。
lines.en: I watch him until leaving feels rude.

lines.zh: 这笔买卖，我势在必得。
lines.en: This deal is mine to close.

lines.zh: 载运虫也停下来，替我撑场面。
lines.en: The carrier bug halts too, lending me some presence.

lines.zh: 我抡起秤杆，砸在他膝盖上。
lines.en: I swing the scale beam and catch him on the knee.

lines.zh: 别抢我的货，我这条老命很硬。
lines.en: Do not rob my wagon; this old life is tough.

lines.zh: 我用秤砣敲他的手，很准。
lines.en: I rap his hand with the weight, quite precisely.

lines.zh: 载运虫冲上去，比我先到。
lines.en: The carrier bug charges in before I do.

lines.zh: 我打人只为护车，不为逞强。
lines.en: I fight only to guard the wagon, never for pride.

lines.zh: 这一下，我赔了一颗门牙。
lines.en: That exchange cost me a front tooth.

lines.zh: 我把货箱推倒，挡住他的路。
lines.en: I tip a crate over to block his path.

lines.zh: 我挥鞭子，其实是打空气，吓唬他。
lines.en: I crack the whip at empty air, just to scare him.

lines.zh: 敢动我的车，我就敢动手。
lines.en: Touch my wagon and I will touch you back.

lines.zh: 打完我第一件事是数货。
lines.en: The first thing I do after a fight is count stock.

lines.zh: 车队在平原上停下，我支起篷布。
lines.en: The caravan stops on the plains and I raise the canvas.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽边的小路转出来，车轮带泥。
lines.en: I roll out of a swamp path with mud on my wheels.

lines.zh: 第一次摆摊，我只有三件货。
lines.en: My first stall had exactly three items on it.

lines.zh: 载运虫从卵里爬出来那天，我开始跑商。
lines.en: I started trading the day my carrier bug hatched.

lines.zh: 我在恶地遇见第一个客人，他买了颗牙齿。
lines.en: My first customer in the badlands bought a tooth.

lines.zh: 那天雨很大，没人来，我等到天黑。
lines.en: It rained hard, nobody came, and I waited till dark.

lines.zh: 我把车停在村口，敲了三下铃。
lines.en: I parked at the village gate and rang the bell three times.

lines.zh: 我的第一批货，是从尸体旁捡的。
lines.en: My first stock came from beside a corpse.

lines.zh: 篷车是新打的，木头还香。
lines.en: The wagon was newly built and the wood still smelled.

lines.zh: 我选了个好位置，就在路口。
lines.en: I picked a good spot, right at the crossroads.

lines.zh: 篷布烧起来，我的货全完了。
lines.en: The canvas caught fire and my whole stock is gone.

lines.zh: 我从车板上摔下来，货压在背上。
lines.en: I fell off the wagon bed with goods on my back.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水漫进车厢，我呛了一口。
lines.en: Swamp water flooded the bed and I choked on it.

lines.zh: 炸得车轮飞了，我趴在地上找秤。
lines.en: The blast threw a wheel off and I crawled looking for my scale.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的耳朵，钉在车辕上。
lines.en: An arrow grazed my ear and stuck in the shaft.

lines.zh: 那道光让我眼前一白，货都看串了。
lines.en: The flash whited my eyes and I mistook one good for another.

lines.zh: 三天没开张，我连自己都想卖。
lines.en: Three days without a sale and I would sell myself.

lines.zh: 雷打在篷顶，我抱着货箱发抖。
lines.en: Lightning hit the canopy and I shook, holding a crate.

lines.zh: 我掉下去时，还抓着一枚绿宝石。
lines.en: Falling, I was still clutching one emerald.
